newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended slightly up on Tuesday, but were off early highs as select blue chips slipped towards the close on selling by investors on the new accounts day, dealers said.
"The index rose on new accounts day buying, but early gains were later trimmed on selling pressure by speculators," dealer Ali Asghar said.

"Investors lack confidence because of country's economic outlook is grim." The Karachi index rose 1.61 points, or 0.11 percent, to end at 1,523.65 from 1,531.05 in early trade. Losers led gainers 145 to 88. Nishat Fabrics rose 1.20 rupees to 14. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
